## Diagnóstico y validación de supuestos

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-height: 5.5
#| fig-width: 18


library(ggplot2); library(patchwork)

df_t <- data.frame(
  ajustados = fitted(modelo_taller),
  residuos  = residuals(modelo_taller),
  std_res   = rstandard(modelo_taller),
  sqrt_std  = sqrt(abs(rstandard(modelo_taller))),
  leverage  = hatvalues(modelo_taller),
  cooks     = cooks.distance(modelo_taller)
)

tema_t <- theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5,
                                    size = 15, color = "#1a3a6b"),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11, color = "#64748b"),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 13, color = "#374151"),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 11, color = "#374151"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border     = element_rect(color = "#cbd5e1", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)
  )

p1 <- ggplot(df_t, aes(ajustados, residuos)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#b91c1c", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(color = "#1a3a6b", size = 2.5, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "#d97706", linewidth = 1.1) +
  labs(title = "Residuos vs. Ajustados", subtitle = "Linealidad",
       x = "Valores ajustados", y = "Residuos") + tema_t

p2 <- ggplot(df_t, aes(sample = std_res)) +
  stat_qq(color = "#1a3a6b", size = 2.5, alpha = 0.75) +
  stat_qq_line(color = "#b91c1c", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Q-Q Plot", subtitle = "Normalidad",
       x = "Cuantiles teóricos", y = "Cuantiles muestrales") + tema_t

p3 <- ggplot(df_t, aes(ajustados, sqrt_std)) +
  geom_point(color = "#1b4d2e", size = 2.5, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "#d97706", linewidth = 1.1) +
  labs(title = "Scale-Location", subtitle = "Homocedasticidad",
       x = "Valores ajustados", y = expression(sqrt("|Res. estand.|"))) + tema_t

p4 <- ggplot(df_t, aes(leverage, std_res)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#b91c1c", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(aes(size = cooks), color = "#7c3aed", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "#d97706", linewidth = 1.1) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 6), guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Residuos vs. Leverage", subtitle = "Obs. influyentes",
       x = "Leverage", y = "Residuos estandarizados") + tema_t

p1 + p2 + p3 + p4

```
